Challenge the assumed **near-term effective capacity of junior hires** first.

- The model assumes junior engineers add less delivery capacity by Q3 and create meaningful onboarding load; both are Olumi-authored estimates, not your evidence.
- That hinges on practical facts: time-to-hire, ramp-up, platform complexity, and whether experienced engineers can mentor and review them.
- It matters more than a generic salary guess because it determines whether “four people” produces more usable Q3 output than two experienced hires.

No model changes or rerun made.
